meta.description: The DEFAULT six-face run in policy mode, with the T-018 relative-geometry clauses. Same shape as six-face-full-run.json (hold fire, hold right while the world scrolls, hop, dodge a houndframe's plant) plus the three things the old grammar could not say: TILT THE GUN UP when the nearest hostile above the firing line is meaningfully above it (the game's aim is 8-way, so a level shot cannot reach the 4.6/7.2 lanes at all — see docs/playtests/2026-08-gate-fight-harness.md); FACE the side that hostile is on during a gate, since facing and moving are the same key; and JUMP AT THE LIP of a hole instead of hopping into it. Note rules 4/5 lean on the documented `99` sentinel on purpose: with nothing above and nothing near, threat.dx>2 reads true, so the bot drifts toward the pivot during the post-clear ritual rather than standing still. MEASURED TWICE, AND THE TWO MEASUREMENTS DISAGREE — READ BOTH. T-018 (2026-08-01, task/T-009's tree pinned at 8751, --deterministic, 1440x900, 245 s cap, ONE run): cleared wave gates 1, 2 and 3, reaching maxX 219.3 / scroll 205 of 415 with 22 kills before spending its third life at 76.9 s; per-tick aim quality against those same fights was 20-29% of gate-1 ticks and 28% of gate-2 ticks with the gun pointing at a hostile, against 8.8% / 12.0% for the aimless script. T-019 (2026-08-01, `main` pinned and served — the last three runs from the task/T-019 worktree, whose src/ is byte-identical to main — --deterministic --stop-on-game-over --max-runtime-ms 145000, 1440x900, ELEVEN runs — 8 at the default sample rate plus 3 at --sample-ms 40): ten of them die inside wave gate 2 at scroll 140 of 415 and the eleventh died in gate 1 at scroll 107, 9-16 kills, surviving 44.1-52.8 s (median 48.7 over the eight default-rate runs). None reached gate 3. TWO things moved between the measurements — the tree under test, and this harness's own terrain.gapDist, which now reads 0 while RIG is over a hole (lib/sampler.mjs) and so changes when this script's last rule (!grounded && vy<0 && terrain.gapDist<1.2) fires — and T-019 did not isolate which. Treat gates 1-2 / scroll 140 as this policy's measured behaviour on main, and the gate-3 run as unreproduced. It does NOT reach VICTORY and no bot run has: the wall, the arithmetic behind it, and the operator packet that has to answer the delivery box are in docs/playtests/2026-08-victory-box.md. six-face-spaced-run.json is the better-measured policy (median 53.1 s over 9 runs, same gate) — start there. Run-to-run spread is +/-6 s, so read the gate reached, never one run's decimals.

outcome.attemptsUnavailableReason: sliceStats.attempts is fixture-only — src/main.js increments it inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)` and this run is the default six-face run, so the counter is structurally frozen at its initial value here. Read outcome.deaths / metrics.lives.

servedFixture.source: window.HB.fixture + HB.snapshot() on the served page

outcome.attemptsUnavailableReason: sliceStats.attempts is fixture-only — src/main.js increments it inside `if (ACTIVE_FIXTURE)` and this run is the default six-face run, so the counter is structurally frozen at its initial value here. Read outcome.deaths / metrics.lives.

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

metrics.deathsScope: stock lives spent on the default six-face run (player.lives decreases; fixtures do not spend lives, this run is not one). HULL FALLBACK absorptions (?fallback=1) cost no life — see metrics.score.setbacks — so a fallback-armed run's failure story is both numbers.

lives.note: stock lives spent, from player.lives on the telemetry channel. Inside a fixture this is 0 by design — fixtures retry instead of spending a life; metrics.deaths names the counter that applies to THIS run.

route.unavailableReason: the served build is running the DEFAULT six-face run (window.HB.snapshot().corner is present, so ACTIVE_FIXTURE === null): it authors no connectors, no routes and no dare pocket, so there is nothing for this metric to be computed against

protoScore.unavailableReason: the A.5 `links` term cannot be approximated on this build: the served build is running the DEFAULT six-face run (window.HB.snapshot().corner is present, so ACTIVE_FIXTURE === null): it authors no connectors, no routes and no dare pocket, so there is nothing for this metric to be computed against. Run with ?score=1 for the game's own event-derived link count (metrics.score), which needs no route matcher.
